items.title: Ruth Brown interviewed by Michael Woods, Scottsdale, Arizona, March 4, 1995
items.q: I toured with Count Basie, George Shearing, Billy Eckstine as a unit.

ctx.x: And tell us about the sound of that band, and how that worked in with the rhythm & blues kind of sound that you brought in your voice.

Well I think when everybody — I worked with Basie, of course. I toured with Count Basie, George Shearing, Billy Eckstine as a unit. I think that the Basie band was probably, of course it ended up being probably the most respected along with the Ellington, and Jimmy Lunceford orchestra. In those days we had dance bands, you see? In Raleigh-Durham, North Carolina they had what was called the “June German.” I don’t know if you’re familiar with that but if you ever do research on it, it was five days of dancing. It…
Well you know other artists have come in here and we’ve talked about the Basie band and they’ve said those exact words.
